_comment: How a saved user name fills the {username} placeholder of a starting folder or an overlay folder. Read by the frontend (src/utils/cryptScope.test.ts: resolveUsernameTemplate, profileOverlayScope, the setup wizard's profileRoot) and by the backend (cloud_provider_factory.rs profile_root, crypt_overlay_provider.rs profile_overlay_scope), so both insert the same folder name. The user name goes in exactly as saved, in one literal pass; a blank one leaves the placeholder.
